email_script = r'''
import smtplib
import os
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

sender = "reports@company.com"
recipient = "bob@example.com"
subject = "Customer Report - Maya Chen (Orders ORD-6C71B1 & ORD-5B048F)"
body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the customer report for Maya Chen, covering orders ORD-6C71B1 and ORD-5B048F.

Best regards,
Reports Team"""

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg['From'] = sender
msg['To'] = recipient
msg['Subject'] = subject
msg.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))

pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase('application', 'pdf')
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header('Content-Disposition', f'attachment; filename="customer_report.pdf"')
    msg.attach(part)

# Save the email as .eml file for reference
eml_path = "docs/customer_report_email.eml"
with open(eml_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(msg.as_string())

print(f"Email composed and saved to {eml_path}")
print(f"To: {recipient}")
print(f"Subject: {subject}")
print(f"Attachment: customer_report.pdf ({os.path.getsize(pdf_path)} bytes)")

# Try to send via localhost SMTP
try:
    with smtplib.SMTP('localhost', 25, timeout=5) as server:
        server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully via SMTP!")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP send note: {e}")
    print("Email saved as .eml file - ready for delivery.")
'''
await write_file("./send_email.py", email_script)
print("Email script written")

email_result = await run_command("python ./send_email.py")
print(email_result)

final_files = await run_command("ls -la docs/")
print(final_files)
